caption: The drawing features two stylized roosters facing each other in the center, each with a brown body, a reddish-brown head and neck, and multi-colored tail feathers in shades of blue, orange, and brown. The background behind the roosters is divided horizontally into sections of blue, pink, and green. Surrounding the central scene, there is a border with an intricate pattern of curling green and blue vines interspersed with round, red fruit-like shapes. The outer edge of the drawing is framed by a thick, wavy dark brown line. The entire image is rectangular and positioned against an off-white backdrop.
title: Embroidered Rug
